title: 第30章 与刘知柔见面
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳猛地抽回自己的胳膊，轻轻摇了摇头，语气冰冷说：“我现在对你，只会唱伍佰的《浪人情歌》。”

    说完，他扭头就走。

    唐欣悦看着他毫不犹豫的背影，脸色变得复杂起来，有委屈，有不甘，还有一丝愤怒。

    她咬了咬牙，猛地冲上前，再次拦住陈阳，恼羞成怒地指着他的鼻子骂道：“陈阳，你得意什么！就算你有200万，那又怎样？你怎么跟赵凯比？”

    她深吸一口气，语气带着几分炫耀和不屑：“赵凯今年的年薪将高达100多万，而你一个小厨师，一年顶天也就十来万！

    再说，你那200万还不知道是从哪个地方偷来的、骗来的，小心惹祸上门，到时候哭都来不及！”

    陈阳冷眼看着她，眼神里满是嘲讽，没有丝毫要解释的意思。

    就在这时，一辆红色的小轿车缓缓开了过来，稳稳地停在两人身边。

    车窗降下，开车的正是姜小媚。

    她穿着一身干练的白领制服，头发束成低马尾，脸上化着精致的淡妆，眉眼间带着几分娇俏，看到陈阳，脸上立刻露出甜美的笑容：“陈主管，总算又跟上你了。”

    她说着，连忙熄了火，推开车门下来，快步走到副驾驶旁，打开车门，恭敬说：“陈主管，请上车。”

    陈阳刚才在银行里接到姜小媚的电话，便给她发了定位，没想到她来得这么快。

    他点了点头，径直弯腰上了副驾驶。

    一旁的唐欣悦看到这一幕，彻底愣住了，脸上满是意外，心中暗自嘀咕：姜小媚怎么会在这里？

    她怎么对陈阳这么客气、这么尊敬，还叫他陈主管？

    他们之间是什么关系？

    眼看姜小媚就要上车，唐欣悦连忙开口叫住她：“姜小媚！”

    姜小媚停下脚步，扭头看到唐欣悦，脸上的笑容瞬间消失，取而代之的是一丝不屑，轻笑一声：“原来是你这个扫把星啊。”

    说完，她转身就要上车。

    唐欣悦连忙快步跟上，语气带着几分不满和疑惑：“你说什么？你骂谁扫把星？”

    姜小媚停在车旁，回头瞥了她一眼，语气带着几分嘲讽：“骂你啊，不然还能骂谁？你还不知道发生什么事了吧？”

    唐欣悦皱起眉头，满脸疑惑：“知道什么？发生什么事？”
content_en:
Chen Yang jerked his arm away, shook his head slightly, and said in a cold tone: "I can only sing Wu Bai's "Roman Love Song" to you now."

After saying that, he turned and left.

Tang Xinyue looked at his unhesitating back, her face became complicated, showing grievance, unwillingness, and a hint of anger.

She gritted her teeth, rushed forward, stopped Chen Yang again, pointed at his nose angrily and cursed: "Chen Yang, what are you proud of! Even if you have 2 million, so what? How can you compare with Zhao Kai?"

She took a deep breath, and her tone was a bit showy and disdainful: "Zhao Kai's annual salary this year will be as high as more than 1 million, and you, a little chef, can only earn more than 100,000 yuan a year!

Besides, you don’t know where you stole or defrauded your 2 million, so if you get into trouble, you won’t even have time to cry!"

Chen Yang looked at her coldly, his eyes full of ridicule, without any intention of explaining.

At this moment, a red car slowly drove over and stopped steadily beside the two of them.

The window was lowered and it was Jiang Xiaomei who was driving.

She was wearing a smart white-collar uniform, her hair was tied into a low ponytail, her face was lightly made up, and her eyebrows were a bit delicate. When she saw Chen Yang, a sweet smile immediately appeared on her face: "Director Chen, I'm finally following you again."

As she spoke, she quickly turned off the engine, opened the door and got out, walked quickly to the passenger side, opened the door, and said respectfully: "Director Chen, please get in the car."

Chen Yang just received a call from Jiang Xiaomei in the bank and sent her her location. He didn't expect her to arrive so quickly.

He nodded and bent straight over to get into the passenger seat.

Tang Xinyue on the side was completely stunned when she saw this scene, her face was full of surprise, and she secretly muttered in her heart: Why is Jiang Xiaomei here?

Why is she so polite and respectful to Chen Yang and still calls him Manager Chen?

What is the relationship between them?

Seeing that Jiang Xiaomei was about to get in the car, Tang Xinyue quickly called out to her: "Jiang Xiaomei!"

Jiang Xiaomei stopped and turned around to see Tang Xinyue. The smile on her face disappeared instantly, replaced by a trace of disdain, and she chuckled: "So it's you, the broom star."

After saying that, she turned around and was about to get in the car.

Tang Xinyue hurriedly followed up with a hint of dissatisfaction and confusion in her tone: "What did you say? Who are you calling the bad guy?"

Jiang Xiaomei stopped next to the car, glanced back at her, and said in a mocking tone: "I'm scolding you, who else could I scold? You don't know what happened, do you?"

Tang Xinyue frowned, with confusion on her face: "What do you know? What happened?"
